Akizungumza katika ziara yake mjini Johannesburg, Afrika Tsvangirai, amesema kwamba ni wakati muafaka kwa Rais Mbeki kubadili msimamo wake na kuziweka kando sera zake za kutomkosoa kiongozi huyo wa Zimbabwe. Aidha anasisitiza kwamba wananchi wa Zimbabwe wanaohitaji uhuru na uchaguzi huru wanaongea juu ya ujasiri wa Rais Mbeki, ambaye hawiwi wamekusitisha msimamo wake wa kumuunga mkozo hiyo. Kiongozi wa MDC anasema kwamba sasa ni wakati wa Mbeki kupaza sauti yake na kutoa micelance wananchi wanaohitaji uhuru. Tsvangirai anamni kwamba Mbeki ataweza kufanikiwa kufanya hilo kwa sababu hawezi kupatwa na masahibu ambayo wamekuwa wakifanyiwa.

Hata kuvumili kwamba uchumi wa Zimbabwe umeshuka chini kwa Afrika Kusini, Mbeki amekaa kimya na kumpinga Mugabe, ambaye anataka kuwania awamu ya sita ya urais katika uchaguzi unaotarajiwa kufanyika tarehe ishirini na tisa ya mwezi ujao. Miliona watatu wa Wazimbabwe wamepata njia ya kufika Afrika Kusini kwa maajili ya kutafutia ajira na kutoa wimbi kutoka kuporomoka kwa uchumi. Tsvangirai anasema kwamba Mbeki ameshinikiza Mugabe, mwenye umri mkubwa, ili kuzuia ongezeko la wakimbizi.

Kwa upande mwingine, kampeni ya uchaguzi ujao inapambana na joto, Tsvangirai amemshambulia Simba Makoni, mgombea urais na mtumishi mwa ZANU-PF, ambaye alifukuzwa baada ya kuangazia kati yao. Makoni alikuwa mfuasi wa ZANU-PF ambaye aliwania nafasi ya urais. Mugabe ndiye mwakilishi wa ZANU-PF katika uchaguzi. Hapo jana, watu watatu walimvamia ofisini ya Tsvangirai mjini Johannesburg na walipata laptop, simu na fedha. Polisi walisema hakuna yeyote alijeruhiwa.

Katika uchaguzi mkuu mwaka 2002, Tsvangirai alisimama na kushutumu kwamba alishinda kwa sababu Mugabe alifanya udanganyifu wa matokeo. Sasa, ataendelea na kidete ili kuhakikisha kwamba chama chake kinashinda.
translated_content:
Speaking during his visit to Johannesburg, South Africa, Tsvangirai stated that it's time for President Mbeki to change his position and step down from his role in mediating the Zimbabwean crisis. He argues that the people of Zimbabwe yearning for freedom and free elections now require Mbeki to demonstrate leadership, as he has been seen as favoring the dictator who has fled to South Africa to evade justice. The MDC leader also asserted that it's now Mbeki's time to amplify the voices of those seeking freedom. Tsvangirai is confident Mbeki can accomplish this because he won't be swayed by the same forces that have been oppressing them. He further suggests that he might face arrest, tear gas, beatings, harassment, and even witness the murder of his supporters, but he must speak truth to power and address these challenges head-on.

Despite Zimbabwe's economic downturn in the region, Mbeki has remained silent and refused to criticize Mugabe, who is seeking a sixth term in the upcoming elections on March 29th. It's estimated that three million Zimbabweans have fled to neighboring South Africa in search of employment and to escape the crumbling economy. Tsvangirai accuses Mbeki of protecting Mugabe, an 83-year-old, from increased international pressure. As the election campaign heats up, Tsvangirai has also blamed Simba Makoni, a former ZANU-PF official now running for president, for contributing to Zimbabwe's economic downfall. Makoni was expelled from ZANU-PF yesterday following his declaration to contest the presidency. Mugabe remains the party's candidate in the election.

Yesterday, three individuals allegedly broke into Tsvangirai's Johannesburg office and stole a laptop, a phone, and cash before he could escape. Police spokesperson Thembi Nkhwasu confirmed that no one was injured during the incident, which involved Tsvangirai and two other MDC members.

Mahakama ya Rufaa ya Paris imethibitisha uamuzi uliotolewa na majaji mwishoni mwa mwaka **2023** wa kufuta kesi dhidi ya washirika saba wa Rais wa Rwanda Paul Kagame, ambao walishtakiwa kwa kudungua ndege ya rais Habyarimana na ntume wake. 

Shambulio hilo linachukuliwa kuwa ndio chanzo cha mauaji ya kimbari yaliyotokea mwaka **1990** nchini Rwanda. 

Mahakama y Rufaa haijaelezea sababu zake kwa kuchukuwa uamuzi huu. Uamuzi unaungana na fahamisho mpya ambapo upande wa utetezi unasema umefurahishwa na uamuzi huo, hata kama uamuzi huu haufunge kabisa faili hii. Vyama vya kiraia tayari vimetangaza kukata rufaa na kutoelekezwa na kanuni.

Mwaka **2020**, Mahakama ya mwanzo nchini humo ilifutilia mbali kesi hiyo, ambayo ilianzishwa tangu miaka 20 iliyopita. 

Kesi hii ya 'mauaji na kula njama kwa ushirikiano kundi la kigaidi' ilifunguliwa nchini Ufaransa mnamo mwaka **1995**, kufuatia malalamiko yaliyotolewa na familia za marubani kutoka Ufaransa, waliokuwa wakiendesha ndege hiyo ya rais Habyarimana na ntume wake.

Majaji wawili wa Ufaransa wa kitengo kinachopambana dhidi ya ugaidi waliokuwa wakishughulikia kesi hiyo waliamua kuachana nayo **Desemba 25, 2023**, 'baada ya kukosekana ushahidi wa kutosha', kwa mujibu wa majaji hao ambao pia walibaini kuwepo na hoja zinazopingana na ambazo hazikuchunguzwa kuhusiana na ushahidi uliokusanywa. 

Mawakili wa upande wa mashitaka wanataka hasa kwamba mahakama ya Ufaransa ipate ripoti ya siri ya mwaka **2005** kutoka kwa Mahakama ya Kimataifa ya Makosa ya Jinai iliyoundwa kwa ajali ya Rwanda.
translated_content:
The Paris Appeal Court has confirmed a ruling issued by judges late in the year **2023** to dismiss a case against seven associates of Rwandan President Paul Kagame, who were accused of bringing down President Habyarimana's plane and his co-pilot.

This ruling is viewed as the catalyst for the genocide that occurred in Rwanda in **1990**.

The Appeal Court has not provided detailed reasoning for this decision. The dismissal aligns with a new interpretation where the prosecution claims satisfaction with the ruling, despite it not fully addressing the case file. Victim groups have already announced plans to appeal and legally contest the ruling.

In **2020**, the initial court in France had previously dismissed this case, which had been ongoing for over 20 years.

This case, involving 'acts of assassination and complicity with a terrorist group,' was initiated in France in **1995**, following complaints from relatives of French citizens who served as crew on Habyarimana's plane.

Two French judges investigating the case decided to drop it on **December 25, 2023**, 'after deeming the evidence insufficient,' according to the judges, who also cited 'contradictory documents that were not adequately scrutinized' related to the presented evidence.

Plaintiffs' lawyers anticipate that the French courts will secure a confidential report from **2005** by the International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda.

article_content: Shirika la Kimataifa la Haki za Binaadamu la Amnesty International lenye makaazi yake mjini London linakadiria kuwa watu elfu 50,000 wanashikiliwa katika magereza ya Iraq, huku wengine kadhaa wakifa wakiwa vizuizini. Mkurugenzi wa shirika hilo, Malcolm Smart, amesema majeshi ya Iraq yamekuwa yakiwajibika kwa uvunjifu wa haki za mahabusu na kwamba wamekuwa wakiruhusiwa kufanya hivyo bila ya kuadhibiwa na kuwatahadhari. Amesema mamlaka nchini Iraq zinapaswa kuchukua hatua za dhahiri sasa, kuonesha nia yake ya kisiasa kuruhusu haki za binadamu kwa Wairaq wote, kulingana na sheria ya kimataifa na kupelekea hesabu majeshi ya unyanyasaji mwengine yanayokwenda kinyume na haki za watu hao waliko vizuizini. Katika ripoti yake yenye kurasa zipatazo 59, yenye kichwa cha habari 'Unyanyasaji wa Mahabusu', shirika hilo limeorodhesha idadi ya wanaume kadhaa ambao wameteswa ama wamekufa wakiwa mahabusu. Miongoni mwa hao ni Riad Mohammed Saleh al Oqaibi, ambaye alikamatwa Septemba mwaka 2009 na kuwekwa kizuizini mjini Baghdad kabla ya kuhamishwa katika kizuizi cha siri katika mji huohuo wa Baghdad. Maelezo yake yaliyomo katika ripoti hiyo inasemekana wakati alipokuwa akihojiwa, alikuwa akipigwa sana kifuani na kwamba mbavu zake zilivunjiak na ini kuharibika. Alikufa Februari 12 ama 13 mwaka huu kutokana na kuvuja damu kwa ndani. Kulingana na shirika hilo la Amnesty, njia zinazotumiwa kutesa watu hao ni pamoja na nyanya za umeme na mabomba ya mpira. Aidha inasemekana kuwa majeshi ya usalama katika jimbo lenye utawala wake wa ndani la Kurdstan pia ni wakulaamiwa, kwa kutolea mfano kesi moja ambapo mahabusu mmoja alikuwa akishikiliwa kwa zaidi ya miaka 15 bila ya kufunguliwa mashtaka au kuhukumuwa na inadaiwa alikuwa akiteswa na polisi wa Kikurd. Shirika la haki za binadamu la Amnest International linasem pia kwamba katika kipindi cha mwezi wa Aprili wanaume wa Kiiraq walibakwa, kuuawa kwa umeme na kupigwa katika magereza ya siri mjini Baghdad, hali iliyofanya wabunge kutaka kufanyika kwa uchunguzi huru juu ya vitendo vya unyanyasaji magerezani. Tangu kuanzia mwezi wa saba mwaka huu Iraq imechukua majukumu kamili ya kuongoza magereza nchini humo, huku Marekani ikiwajibika katika kitengo kidogo cha mahabusu katika gereza la Karkh nje ya mji mkuu wa nchi hiyo Baghdad. Katika sherehe za za kukabidhiwa udhibiti wa mahabusu ya mwisho iliyokuwa ikishikiliwa na Marekani Julai 15, waziri wa sheria wa Iraq Dara Nureddine Dara alisema siku za kuwanyanyasa na kuwatendea vibaya wafungwa zimekwisha na kwamba watamchunguza na kumchukulia hatua mtu yoyote anatayebainika kufanya makosa.
translated_content: The international human rights organization Amnesty International, based in London, reports that 50,000 people are being detained in Iraqi prisons, with several in solitary confinement. Amnesty International's Middle East and North Africa director, Malcolm Smart, stated that Iraqi authorities have been complicit in the violation of detainees' human rights, acting with impunity. He urged the Iraqi authorities to take immediate visible steps to demonstrate their political commitment to human rights for all Iraqis, in line with international law, and to hold accountable other abusers who act against the rights of those in solitary confinement. In its report titled 'New Torture System,' Amnesty International documents dozens of men who were tortured or killed while in custody. One of them is Riad Mohammed Saleh al Oqaibi, who was arrested in September 2009 and placed in solitary confinement in Baghdad before being moved to a secret prison in the city. According to his account in the report, during interrogation, he was severely beaten, his limbs were dislocated, and he eventually died on February 12th or 13th of this year due to internal bleeding. Amnesty International cites methods of interrogation including electric shocks and psychological torture, such as forcing victims to stay awake for prolonged periods. The organization also alleges complicity by security forces in the autonomous region of Kurdistan. Amnesty International further reports that in April, Iraqi men were beaten, electrocuted, and tortured in secret prisons in Baghdad, leading parliamentarians to demand a free inquiry into prison abuses. Since then, Iraq has assumed full control of its prisons, while the US maintains a small detention facility at Karkh prison outside Baghdad. On July 15th, Iraqi Justice Minister Dara Nureddine Dara declared that days of abuse and mistreatment of detainees were over, and that they would investigate and hold accountable anyone found guilty of misconduct.
